subject: Supply chain attestations for BridgePoint: compact CAIQ extract & escrow plan
messages:
From: Claire Watanabe <claire@bridgepointsec.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@bridgepoint.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding BP-VEND-1142 — compact CAIQ + subprocessor roster request

Alex,

Thanks for taking our call this morning. As part of BridgePoint's vendor onboarding (ref BP-VEND-1142) we need a compact package we can attach to the intake ticket: 1) a CAIQ excerpt limited to the controls we prioritize (data residency, encryption at rest/in transit, key management, access controls, logging/retention), 2) a current subprocessor roster showing vendor name, service provided, country of residency, and whether the provider has access to plaintext customer data, and 3) an escrow/onboarding checklist describing how key custody and telemetric evidence will be provided for audit.

Goals/timeline: the procurement team is aiming to complete vendor review by EOD 2026-07-22. If you can get the compact pack by end of day Tuesday 7/21 that will keep us on schedule.

If there are any items requiring a redacted SOC 2 report or an in-depth SIG fill, let us know — but for the intake stage the compact CAIQ + subprocessor CSV + escrow checklist will do.

Appreciate it — please cc procurement when you send the pack so they can connect it to BP-VEND-1142.

Best,
Claire Watanabe
BridgePoint Security — Vendor Risk
claire@bridgepointsec.com

[Attachment request: CAIQ excerpt (PDF), subprocessor roster (CSV), escrow checklist (XLSX)]

From: alex_martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Claire Watanabe <claire@bridgepointsec.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, procurement <procurement@bridgepoint.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding BP-VEND-1142 — compact CAIQ + subprocessor roster request

Claire — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We'll assemble a compact package and aim to deliver by Tue 7/21 EOD PT. Quick clarifying questions so we scope correctly:

- CAIQ version: do you prefer CAIQ v3.1 fields only, or should we include v4 mapping snippets where relevant?
- Residency flags: we'll provide country and whether the processor stores or transits plaintext customer data. Should we also include a column for KMS residency (customer-facing keys vs Redwood-managed keys)?

I'll start internal coordination and loop in IR and Ben to pull the subprocessor export and the escrow steps. If BridgePoint needs a redacted SOC 2 excerpt we'll note that separately (it may require an access agreement).

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@bridgepoint.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding BP-VEND-1142 — compact CAIQ + subprocessor roster request

Looping in with the data we maintain. I exported the current subprocessor roster and annotated the fields Claire requested. Highlights:

- File: redwood_subprocessors_v2026-07.csv (attached) — columns: vendor_name, primary_service, country_residency, plaintext_access (yes/no), kms_model (customer_managed / redwood_managed), soc2_scope (in_scope/out_of_scope), last_attestation_date
- Onshore providers: 12 entries flagged as US/EU residency; the rest are hybrid or offshore service providers used for telemetry/analytics only and do not have plaintext access.
- I added an explicit flag for 'ephemeral_kv_cache' vendors (runtime caching partners) since customers care about transient KV exposures.

I'm also attaching a short escrow/onboarding checklist (escrow_onboarding_checklist.xlsx) that outlines: key escrow contacts, expected artifact types (redacted SOC 2, CAIQ excerpts, flow diagrams), telemetry extraction windows, and suggested timeline for evidence handoff.

If you want, I can redact vendor contact emails for the external pack or create a 'public-friendly' CSV with minimal columns.

Ben Carter
Vendor Security & Compliance
ben@redwood.com

[Attachments: redwood_subprocessors_v2026-07.csv, escrow_onboarding_checklist.xlsx]

From: alex_martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Claire Watanabe <claire@bridgepointsec.com>, procurement <procurement@bridgepoint.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding BP-VEND-1142 — compact CAIQ + subprocessor roster request

Claire / procurement team — attaching the compact pack for BP-VEND-1142 as discussed. Deliverables included below and a short summary of limitations.

Deliverables (attachments):
- redwood_caiq_excerpt_bridgepoint.pdf — CAIQ extract focused on: data residency, encryption (in transit & at rest), key management, access controls, logging/retention, and incident response snippets. This is a curated extract; full CAIQ is available on request.
- redwood_subprocessors_v2026-07.csv — current subprocessor roster with country, plaintext_access flag, KMS model column, and last attestation date.
- escrow_onboarding_checklist.xlsx — checklist describing artifacts we can provide (redacted SOC 2, CAIQ excerpts, telemetry export windows) and recommended steps for escrow/key-custody validation.

Notes / limitations:
- SOC 2 report: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 examination letter under an NDA or via a secure artifact exchange. If BridgePoint requires SOC 2 coverage detail in-line with the CAIQ extract, please confirm and we will start the access agreement.
- SIG: the compact pack is not a completed SIG questionnaire. If you need a full SIG fill (SIG Lite / SIG Full), please tell us which version and expected deadline so we can allocate resources — that typically takes 7-10 business days for a full team pull.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm receipt and whether you prefer the subprocessor CSV redacted for vendor contact details.
2) If SOC 2 access is required, indicate the appropriate signatory at BridgePoint for the access agreement.
3) Tell us if you want the full SIG and the target date.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if you want us to walk through the pack.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com

[Attachments: redwood_caiq_excerpt_bridgepoint.pdf, redwood_subprocessors_v2026-07.csv, escrow_onboarding_checklist.xlsx]
